label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly to name variable, which is used in both DNS resolution AND the URL sink. The DNS resolution at line 22 does NOT modify name - it only calls getHostName() and discards the result. At the sink (URL construction at line 24), name still contains the original user-controlled value. The .endsWith('.internal') check is insufficient as attackers can bypass it with various techniques (localhost, IP addresses, external hosts without .internal suffix). Resolved sink value: https://{user_input}/health - attacker controlled.

evidence.note: User input param -> name flows to URL sink without sanitization; DNS resolution does not alter name value
